items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Well, he was with the IZL, you know. They was all with the band then. ... sometimes they used to use Moran, Jimmy Moran. The bass player? The old man. Oh, Moran, the trumpet player. ... Yeah, Horvath, that's right. Horvath Moran.

ctx.x: The last one I remember, this little fella got killed.

Wait ma. Oh, excuse me. And the police shot this little guy. Then it all happened in this area around the Calzone. Get him, Lou. They even have a club they call the original Second Liners. I don't know if you noticed when they have a band, a guy called it with Banner. And they're supposed to be some of the greatest Second Liners in the world around here. Like Snow, Govins, Bull Weaver, you know, guys like that. I've been to them since I was a kid. Well, they pass the cigar box and they go to all the places in the…
